#{Decouple utility evaluation from accumulated penalties by estimating base edge distances via total penalty subtraction, guiding targeted symmetric penalties to edges with high intrinsic cost relative to visitation frequency.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    current_edge_lens = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    # Calculate uniform penalty scale proportional to average current tour edge length
    penalty = 0.3 * np.mean(current_edge_lens)
    
    # Recover base edge distance c_ij by discounting prior cumulative penalties (penalty * tour_counts)
    # ensuring utility reflects pristine base metrics rather than runaway inflated costs
    base_distances = np.maximum(current_edge_lens - (tour_counts * penalty), 1e-8)
    
    # Decoupled utility calculation using pristine base distances
    utilities = base_distances / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    
    # Symmetric in-place distance penalty update on maximally viable edges
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalty
    
    return updated_edge_distance
